description: This file defines a TypeScript module for interacting with the Zalo Bot API, including types, error handling, and functions for sending messages, setting webhooks, and retrieving updates.

classes.name: ZaloApiError
classes.description: Custom error class for handling Zalo API errors, including error code and description, with a method to identify polling timeouts.

methods.name: callZaloApi
methods.description: Performs an API call to the Zalo Bot API with specified method, token, and parameters, handling JSON response and errors.

methods.name: getMe
methods.description: Retrieves bot information by validating the bot token.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a text message to a specified chat.

methods.name: sendPhoto
methods.description: Sends a photo message to a specified chat.

methods.name: sendChatAction
methods.description: Sends a temporary chat action such as typing indicator.

methods.name: getUpdates
methods.description: Retrieves updates using long polling, returning a single update object.

methods.name: setWebhook
methods.description: Sets the webhook URL for receiving updates.

methods.name: getWebhookInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the current webhook configuration.
